llm.summary: The skill is primarily documentation-only and mostly consistent with its stated purpose, but it references a shared API key (ZHIPU_API_KEY) and installation commands (npx/git clone) while declaring no required environment variables or installs — a minor but notable mismatch you should review before running any commands it recommends.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the content: this is a documentation-only master index that lists GLM skills, links, and recommended install methods. The catalog entries and links are coherent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only guidance: it tells agents/users how to pick skills and run installers (npx clawhub, git clone) and to set an API key. It does not instruct the agent to execute local scripts or read files itself. However it explicitly instructs users to set ZHIPU_API_KEY and to run remote installers (npx), which will execute code when the user follows them — that behavior is expected for an install guide but worth calling out.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files; the skill is instruction-only. This minimizes direct installation risk from the skill itself. The install methods it recommends (npx clawhub, git clone) are external and normal for package installation, but they do involve fetching and running remote code under the user's control.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md advises users to set ZHIPU_API_KEY for GLM skills, but the skill's declared requirements list no environment variables. That mismatch (documenting a secret without declaring it) is a proportionality/information gap. The skill itself does not request credentials, but it directs users to create/store a potentially sensitive API key for downstream skills; users should verify where that key will be used and consider creating limited-scope keys.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request persistent presence (always is false), has no install-time hooks, and contains no code that would modify agent configuration or other skills. It appears to be a passive, user-invoked documentation guide.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This file is mainly a safe, read-only catalogue of GLM skills, but before following its install commands: (1) verify the GitHub links and the upstream GLM repositories listed here; (2) be cautious when running npx <package> or running git clone — those actions fetch and run code from the network, so confirm the package (clawhub) and repository are authentic; (3) when asked to set ZHIPU_API_KEY, prefer creating a limited-scope or throwaway API key and store it in a secure place rather than pasting secrets into one-off shells; (4) review each individual skill's SKILL.md and repository before installing to ensure you understand what code will run and what credentials it requires.
